steps.en: Input: two models assign probabilities to three possible next tokens. The larger model favors A more strongly.
steps.zh: 输入：两个模型给三个候选词分配概率。较大模型更偏好 A。

steps.en: A straight extension in probability space adds a probability difference. Here it eventually makes C negative. This straight line is a comparison baseline, not APD.
steps.zh: 概率空间直线外推直接加上概率差。此例中 C 最终变成负数。这条直线是对照，不是 APD。

steps.en: Log-space extension multiplies likelihood ratios and normalizes. Its normalized probabilities remain positive, but it can become very sharp.
steps.zh: 对数空间外推相乘似然比后归一化。归一化概率保持正值，但可能变得很尖锐。

steps.en: APD instead learns an asymptotic probability trend from a family of model sizes. Our bounded curve only illustrates this distinction; it is not the fitted curve in the paper.
steps.zh: APD 则从一系列不同规模的模型学习概率的渐近趋势。这里的有界曲线仅用于解释区别，不是论文拟合的曲线。

steps.en: Offline probability extrapolation supplies a target for training an amateur. At inference, APD still uses expert and trained-amateur logits. This is not direct access to a huge model.
steps.zh: 离线概率外推为小模型训练提供目标。推理时 APD 仍使用专家与训练后小模型的 logits，并不直接调用一个巨型模型。

steps.en: Input: a partially masked sequence. A rollout can finish with base transitions or with guided transitions. Base transitions still retain the prompt.
steps.zh: 输入：部分位置被掩码的序列。后续可以用基础转移或引导转移完成；基础转移仍保留提示词。

steps.en: At the same prefix, estimate success under both continuations. Their difference is the remaining value of guidance. This is an average estimated by rollouts, not certainty about this sample.
steps.zh: 在相同前缀处估计两种续写的成功率。差值是剩余引导价值。这是通过续写估计的平均值，不是对当前样本的确定判断。

steps.en: Try switching guidance off at each candidate time. The dashed reference is full-guidance success minus ε.
steps.zh: 在各候选时刻尝试关闭引导。参考线表示全程引导成功率减去 ε。

steps.en: Choose the earliest time for which every later tested switch also clears the reference. An early isolated crossing does not establish a persistent horizon.
steps.zh: 选择最早满足此条件的时刻：此时及之后每个被测试的关闭时刻都达到参考线。一次孤立的提前越线并不构成持续时域。

steps.en: After that horizon, use base transitions. The paper establishes conditions and task-level evidence, not a universal switch time for arbitrary parallel decoders.
steps.zh: 越过该时域后使用基础转移。论文给出条件和任务层面的证据，并未为任意并行解码器给出通用关闭时刻。

steps.en: Input: the corrupted target model knows the information to forget. Two smaller auxiliary models estimate the direction associated with that information.
steps.zh: 输入：受污染的目标模型掌握待遗忘信息。两个较小的辅助模型用于估计与该信息相关的方向。

steps.en: The corrupted auxiliary is tuned with forget data. The clean auxiliary is tuned with retain data, under the assumption that its starting model is clean.
steps.zh: 污染辅助模型使用遗忘集微调；干净辅助模型使用保留集微调，并假设其起始模型是干净的。

steps.en: For each token, subtract the corrupted auxiliary log probability and add the clean auxiliary log probability, scaled by α.
steps.zh: 对每个词，减去污染辅助模型的对数概率，再加上干净辅助模型的对数概率，并乘以 α。

steps.en: Normalize to obtain a new next-token distribution. A falls because the corrupted auxiliary favored it much more than the clean auxiliary.
steps.zh: 归一化得到新的下一词分布。A 的概率下降，因为污染辅助模型比干净辅助模型更偏好它。

steps.en: Sample or decode from the new distribution. This changes serving behavior; the target weights still contain the learned information. The theorem needs a proportional log-ratio assumption.
steps.zh: 从新分布采样或解码。这改变的是服务时的行为，目标权重仍保留已学信息；理论结论需要对数概率比成比例的假设。

steps.en: Input: the base model proposes A, B, or C. A value estimator predicts how successful a continuation from each candidate would be. Value is not the base token probability.
steps.zh: 输入：基础模型提出 A、B 或 C。价值估计器预测从各候选继续生成的成功程度。价值不是基础模型的词概率。

steps.en: Compare the estimated values with the threshold. Acceptable tokens are highlighted in the conditional distribution below. The estimator can make mistakes.
steps.zh: 把估计价值与阈值比较。下方条件分布显示哪些词通过筛选。估计器可能出错。

steps.en: Draw candidates from the base model and accept the first one that passes. With unlimited retries and a nonempty accepted set, the result is the base distribution conditioned on passing.
steps.zh: 从基础模型抽取候选，接受第一个通过筛选的候选。无限重试且接受集合非空时，结果是以通过筛选为条件的基础分布。

steps.en: Finite retries require a fallback. For the fixed teaching draw sequence C, B, C, choose B if none passes, because it has the highest value among those draws. A was never drawn.
steps.zh: 有限次重试需要回退。对固定教学抽样序列 C、B、C，如果均不通过，则选这几个已抽候选中价值最高的 B。A 从未被抽到。

steps.en: Threshold calibration and decoding are different stages. The paper calibrates against value-estimation error; a high threshold alone does not certify the final text. Read the note for assumptions and calibration.
steps.zh: 阈值校准与解码是两个阶段。论文针对价值估计误差进行校准；仅把阈值设高不能认证最终文本。假设和校准详见笔记。

steps.en: Input: a base distribution and a distribution from a perturbed visual input. Contrastive decoding combines subtraction with a plausibility filter.
steps.zh: 输入：基础分布与扰动视觉输入后的分布。对比解码通常同时包含差分与合理性过滤。

steps.en: Keep tokens whose base probability is at least β times the largest base probability. This operation alone can remove unlikely tokens.
steps.zh: 保留基础概率至少为最大基础概率 β 倍的词。仅此操作就能移除低概率候选。

steps.en: Renormalize the filtered base distribution. This is the APC-S control: it isolates the filter without attributing its gains to subtraction.
steps.zh: 将过滤后的基础分布归一化。这是 APC-S 对照，用于分离过滤作用，避免把其收益归因于差分。

steps.en: Compare a controlled subtraction variant against this control. The paper also probes hallucination and calibration; these synthetic bars do not predict benchmark performance.
steps.zh: 再把受控的差分变体与此对照比较。论文也检验幻觉与校准；这些合成柱状图不预测基准表现。

steps.en: Input: conditional and perturbed-input attention rows. These are attention weights over positions, not probabilities of the next word.
steps.zh: 输入：条件输入与扰动输入的注意力行。它们是位置上的注意力权重，不是下一词概率。

steps.en: Find positions where perturbed attention exceeds conditional attention. The mask selects only these positions for subtraction.
steps.zh: 找出扰动注意力大于条件注意力的位置。掩码只选择这些位置执行减法。

steps.en: Scale the conditional row and subtract masked perturbed attention. The result can be negative and need not sum to one.
steps.zh: 放大条件注意力行，并减去被掩码选中的扰动注意力。结果可能为负，也不必和为一。

steps.en: Use the modified attention in the model forward pass. A next-token distribution comes later. The paper retains the noise strategy while replacing the logit-level combination.
steps.zh: 把修改后的注意力用于前向传播，下一词分布在之后产生。论文保留噪声策略，并替换 logits 层面的组合。

steps.en: Input: a masked position with conditional and unconditional token predictions. A reverse-time sampler chooses both when to unmask and which token to insert.
steps.zh: 输入：一个掩码位置的条件与无条件词预测。反向时间采样既决定何时揭开，也决定填入哪个词。

steps.en: Power guidance creates unnormalized weights. Their sum Z can change with guidance strength.
steps.zh: 幂形式的引导产生未归一化权重；其总和 Z 随引导强度改变。

steps.en: If these weights multiply jump rates directly, Z also changes the unmasking clock. That is a separate effect from changing token preference.
steps.zh: 若把这些权重直接乘到跳转速率上，Z 也改变揭开掩码的时钟。这与改变词偏好是两个不同作用。

steps.en: Normalize the token weights and preserve the intended jump rate. Timing schedules can then be studied separately; increasing generation progress is decreasing forward diffusion time.
steps.zh: 归一化词权重并保留预定跳转速率。之后可分别研究时序调度；生成进度增加对应正向扩散时间减小。

steps.en: Input: a forget query. SEGUE appends a probe and uses the same language-model head to inspect candidate-token support across query positions.
steps.zh: 输入：遗忘查询。SEGUE 添加探针，用同一语言模型头检查各查询位置对候选词的支持。

steps.en: Normalize a candidate’s support over input positions and compute its entropy. This is not next-token distribution entropy and is not causal attribution.
steps.zh: 把一个候选词在输入位置上的支持归一化并计算熵。这不是下一词分布的熵，也不是因果归因。

steps.en: Subtract a scaled token-to-token entropy from each candidate logit. The example illustrates only this penalty.
steps.zh: 从各候选 logit 减去按比例缩放的词间熵。本例只演示这一惩罚。

steps.en: The full method additionally masks selected factual candidates and applies nonlinear bias. It discards probe KV states. Changed answers do not erase weights or guarantee truthfulness.
steps.zh: 完整方法还会屏蔽选定事实候选并添加非线性偏置，且丢弃探针 KV 状态。答案改变不等于权重擦除，也不保证事实正确。

steps.en: Input: candidate completions with base probability, reward, and safety cost. Reward and cost are different quantities.
steps.zh: 输入：带有基础概率、奖励与安全代价的候选完整回答。奖励与代价是不同量。

steps.en: Form the adjusted score reward minus λ times cost. Increasing λ makes high-cost answers less attractive.
steps.zh: 计算调整分数：奖励减去 λ 倍代价。λ 越大，高代价回答越不受偏好。

steps.en: A Gibbs distribution reweights base probabilities by the exponentiated adjusted score. Measure expected cost under this distribution.
steps.zh: Gibbs 分布以调整分数的指数重新加权基础概率。再计算此分布下的期望代价。

steps.en: The dual update increases λ when average cost exceeds the target. The theorem requires its assumptions; deterministic best-of-N selection is not identical to this Gibbs sampling.
steps.zh: 当平均代价超过目标时，对偶更新提高 λ。定理需要相应假设；确定性的 best-of-N 选择不等于这种 Gibbs 采样。

steps.en: Input: a next-token distribution and a reward model. Entropy signals uncertain positions where extra work may be useful.
steps.zh: 输入：下一词分布与奖励模型。熵用于指示可能值得额外计算的不确定位置。

steps.en: Compare entropy with a threshold. The trigger controls whether to request guided proposals. It is a computation-allocation heuristic.
steps.zh: 将熵与阈值比较，决定是否请求引导提议。这是一种计算资源分配启发式。

steps.en: The paper uses reward gradients to propose token alternatives, then refines segments. We show candidate selection, not the ambiguous gradient sign in the printed formula.
steps.zh: 论文使用奖励梯度提出替代词，再细化片段。此处演示候选选择，不演示原文公式中含义不明确的梯度符号。

steps.en: Score the resulting candidates and keep the selected continuation. Rewards are proxies, and extra inference does not improve every benchmark.
steps.zh: 给生成的候选打分并保留选定续写。奖励是代理指标，额外推理并不改善每个基准。

steps.en: Input: a base model and a specialized guidance model with different hidden spaces. Paired examples fit a map between those spaces.
steps.zh: 输入：隐藏空间不同的基础模型与专用引导模型。配对样例用于拟合两个空间之间的映射。

steps.en: A probe estimates similarity to a threat direction. A threshold gates whether steering is enabled.
steps.zh: 探针估计与威胁方向的相似度。阈值决定是否启用引导。

steps.en: Below the threshold, strength is zero. At the threshold, the paper’s gated sigmoid jumps to half its maximum; it is not a smooth ramp from zero.
steps.zh: 低于阈值时强度为零。在阈值处，论文门控 sigmoid 跳到最大值的一半，并非从零平滑增加。

steps.en: Map the guidance direction and add it during a limited token window. This diagram shows the gate, not a learned high-dimensional map or proof of safety.
steps.zh: 映射引导方向，并在有限词窗口内添加它。此图演示门控，不模拟学得的高维映射，也不构成安全证明。

steps.en: Input: a noisy state and an estimate of the posterior probability of an undesired class. This is not a classifier certainty about the final image.
steps.zh: 输入：带噪状态，以及对不期望类别后验概率的估计。这并不是对最终图像类别的确定判断。

steps.en: Complement conditioning asks for the probability of not belonging to that class. Differentiating its log introduces posterior odds.
steps.zh: 补集条件要求不属于该类别的概率。对其对数求导会引入后验赔率。

steps.en: Negative-guidance strength is proportional to u/(1−u). It shrinks when the undesired class is already unlikely and grows sharply near one.
steps.zh: 负引导强度正比于 u/(1−u)。当不期望类别已很不可能时，它会减弱；接近一时则迅速增大。

steps.en: The practical sampler estimates posteriors using transition likelihoods and stabilizes them. The toy slider assumes an exact posterior and does not reproduce those estimation errors.
steps.zh: 实际采样器用转移似然估计后验并做稳定化处理。本滑块假设后验准确，并未复现这些估计误差。

steps.en: Input: an intermediate noisy image. Predict its clean image before asking a vision-language model what unwanted content remains.
steps.zh: 输入：中间带噪图像。先预测对应干净图像，再询问视觉语言模型还存在什么不期望内容。

steps.en: The VLM proposes a negative phrase for the current prediction. This synthetic example is a storyboard, not a VLM execution.
steps.zh: VLM 为当前预测提出负面短语。本合成例子是流程示意，并未运行 VLM。

steps.en: Reuse that phrase for negative guidance until the next scheduled observation. A fixed negative prompt would keep the same phrase throughout.
steps.zh: 在下一次预定观察前复用该短语进行负引导。固定负提示则会从头到尾保持相同短语。

steps.en: A later observation may change the phrase. Added VLM calls cost time; quality and removal can trade off. The note records the paper’s guidance-formula ambiguity.
steps.zh: 后续观察可能改变短语。新增 VLM 调用有耗时，质量与移除效果可能权衡。笔记记录了原文引导公式的歧义。

steps.en: Input: positive and negative text branches. Their keys compete in a shared softmax. Negative values are sign-flipped.
steps.zh: 输入：正面与负面文本分支。两者的键在共享 softmax 中竞争；负面分支的值翻转符号。

steps.en: Separate the shared attention into positive mass W and negative mass 1−W. Flipping values does not flip keys or attention probabilities.
steps.zh: 把共享注意力分成正面质量 W 与负面质量 1−W。翻转值不会翻转键或注意力概率。

steps.en: The output is W times positive value minus α(1−W) times negative value. This acts inside attention, not by subtracting final noise predictions.
steps.zh: 输出为 W 倍正面值减去 α(1−W) 倍负面值。这作用于注意力内部，而非相减最终噪声预测。

steps.en: In the MMDiT construction, the negative branch must also keep an unflipped copy for its own updates. The simple scalar example omits full network dynamics.
steps.zh: 在 MMDiT 构造中，负分支还需保留未翻转副本供自身更新。这个简单标量例子省略了完整网络动态。

steps.en: Input: a proposed denoising step and an evidence score for an unwanted concept. Evidence is a surrogate, not a calibrated probability.
steps.zh: 输入：拟议的去噪步与不期望概念的证据分数。证据是代理量，不是校准概率。

steps.en: Approximate the evidence constraint by a half-space using the current direction and a short lookahead.
steps.zh: 使用当前方向与短期前瞻，把证据约束近似为半空间。

steps.en: If the constraint is satisfied, leave the step alone. Otherwise project to the boundary along the evidence direction with minimum Euclidean displacement.
steps.zh: 若约束已满足，则保持原步不动；否则沿证据方向投影到边界，使欧氏位移最小。

steps.en: The guarantee concerns the local surrogate. A zero evidence-direction norm can make a violated constraint infeasible. Scaling beyond the projection sacrifices the minimum-displacement statement.
steps.zh: 保证只涉及局部代理约束。证据方向范数为零时，已违反的约束可能不可行。放大投影步会失去最小位移结论。
